Name: Fertilizer Level Up
Author: Furuchooo
Description:
Just an option to craft weaker fertilizer into better ones, also allow you to exchange between Basic Fertilizer and Tree Fertilizer

You can convert Basic Fertilizer into Quality Fertilizer and Quality Fertilizer into Deluxe Fertilizer.

The conversion is 4 to 1

You learn Basic to Quality at Level 6 Farming and Quality to Deluxe at level 9

You can also convert Basic Fertilizer to Tree Fertilizer and vice-versa in a rate of 2 to 1
